name: wrapper-statusline-callback
note: router.on_statusline(payload) callback fed by the statusline relay

name: wrapper-history-backward
note: consumed by agent-orchestrator task fake-wrapper-contract (before_seq, types, prev_seq, has_more_before)

name: any-mcp-cli
note: console script any-mcp: --config <path> (or ANY_MCP_CONFIG), --plugin, --transport stdio|http, --version, --help exits 0; exit 78 on config errors; stdio default

name: any-mcp-config
note: YAML: server, tools, python_path, plugins[] (name, plugin, namespace, allow, tags, timeout, reload_every, config); unknown keys rejected; VAR expansion

name: any-mcp-release
note: tag v0.1.0: pip install 'any-mcp @ git+https://github.com/szymonrychu/any-mcp@v0.1.0'; console script any-mcp

name: any-mcp-install
note: onStart hook: python -m venv /opt/any-mcp && /opt/any-mcp/bin/pip install 'any-mcp @ git+https://github.com/szymonrychu/any-mcp@v0.1.0'; writes any-mcp.yaml as JSON (valid YAML) using stdlib only; console script /opt/any-mcp/bin/any-mcp

name: agent-orchestrator-chart
note: oci://harbor.szymonrichert.pl/charts/agent-orchestrator (immutable versions: X.Y.Z on tag vX.Y.Z, X.Y.Z-main.<sha7> on main); values: image, agentImage, postgres {url | host, port, database, user, password | existingSecret, existingSecretKey} (required unless cnpg.enabled), cnpg {enabled: false, instances, storage, backup}, masterKey {existingSecret | value}, claude {existingSecret | token}, env (extra ORCH_*), components {api, dispatcher, ingester, reconciler}, serviceAccount, rbac.create, service, ingress {enabled: false, className, annotations, hosts, tls}; everything in the release namespace

name: agent-orchestrator-settings-env
note: ORCH_* env names: ORCH_DATABASE_URL, ORCH_MASTER_KEY(_FILE), ORCH_NAMESPACE (one namespace, no ORCH_CLUSTERS_NAMESPACE), ORCH_AGENT_IMAGE, ORCH_AGENT_IMAGES, ORCH_ALLOWED_CIDRS, ORCH_CLAUDE_SECRET_NAME, ORCH_ANY_MCP_REF, ORCH_ANY_MCP_CONFIG_FILE, ORCH_DISCARD_HOOK_COMMAND, ORCH_DISCARD_HOOK_URL, ORCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_*; set by the chart's settings ConfigMap

name: agent-orchestrator-image
note: harbor.szymonrichert.pl/containers/agent-orchestrator:<sha7> only (no derived agent image); agents run the claude-code-wrapper image set as agentImage / ORCH_AGENT_IMAGE, any-mcp installed by the rendered onStart hook

name: wrapper-on-start-hook
note: hooks.onStart: instance event fired once per ccw process start before peer join, resume_on_start and any session; blocking deny or on_error deny failure exits 1; envelope like preJoin, runs in the sessions root
